title: Make staging and production deploy workflows dispatch-only and reconcile the account model
description:
## Plan step 2 (product PR into develop, sub-agent review)
Change deploy-web-*, deploy-thinturn-*, deploy-controlplane-* and deploy-auth-* for staging and production from on:push main to workflow_dispatch only. Route web, auth and thin-turn through deploy-chatticus-dedicated-account.sh (or remove the legacy scripts) so no workflow mixes legacy and dedicated account models; remove duplicated control-plane redeploys across thinturn/web/controlplane. Later re-enable push for staging only once bootstrapped; production stays dispatch plus environment reviewer.

## Why
A push to main otherwise fires nine deploys with no gate; deploy-auth-* redeploys legacy Cognito from new code; a thin-turn deploy into the legacy account would delete the Python Lambdas.
## Decision: D1.
## Acceptance
- No deploy-*-staging/production workflow has a push trigger.
- A cucumber or workflow-lint guard fails if one gains a push trigger on main.
- No workflow invokes both legacy and dedicated-account scripts.
- Related: chatticus-36012d, chatticus-96e12b.
Source: docs/PROMOTE_TO_MAIN.md (PR 534, branch ts/promote-to-main-plan). Nothing has been executed; owner decisions are in the 'Decisions needed from the owner' ticket.
right_now_summary: The team is planning gated, manual deployments and aligning workflows with the dedicated account model.
